panels.body: Your support keeps independent work personal, human, and close to home.
panels.art_direction: Polished first-purchase card design with a central soft houseplant motif, airy pastel palette, and a subtle border.
panels.image_prompt: A soft, pastel-colored 5x7 card with a central watercolor houseplant and a subtle, rounded border. No words, letters, handwriting, calligraphy, labels, signatures, or fake text. No people. No hands. No logos. No watermark. Avoid all-over repeating wallpaper patterns; use restrained hierarchy and negative space. No caption plaque, no text box, no inner card rectangle, no blank tag, no label.
